name: jevmem
description: jevmem keeps your project's decisions, rules and failed approaches in JEVMEM.md in your repo, shared with your team through git, and checks Claude's commands and edits against those rules before they run. It saves them from your chats and brings the relevant lines back next session, beside Claude Code's own memory. Needs the jevmem CLI from npm and a TypeSafe API key. Opt-in per project.

typesafe_api_key.title: TypeSafe API key
typesafe_api_key.description: Your TypeSafe AI key for Jev (https://console.typesafe.ai/keys). Kept in your system's secure credential store. Leave empty to use TYPESAFE_API_KEY from the environment or ~/.jevmem/env.
